title: 第2536章 收赵玉霖为徒第2535章 老者的真实目的
content_zh:
见小乞丐明白了，陆宸又趁机教育道：“小霖，有些坏人是直接的坏，有些坏人则是虚伪的坏，就像你这假爷爷一样，他们会装好人，这种坏人更危险，你以后要更小心这类坏人。”
小乞丐认真记下：“恩公，小霖记下了。”
李裕祁则是不服的一脸嘲讽：“说得好像你是什么好人一样，你还不是惦记这个小畜生的肉身，想要夺舍了这个小畜生，要不然你会救这么一个蝼蚁？”
“人和人是不同的，你永远也理解不了我做的事。”
陆宸冷漠道。
李裕祁根本不信，又对小乞丐道：“小畜生，你就等着吧，等到你实力稍微强一点，他就会夺了你的肉身，变成你，因为即便是武圣也拒绝不了你这肉身的诱惑。”
陆宸讥讽道：“你不用费尽心思的挑拨我和小霖之间的关系，因为我不可能夺舍他。”
“我不信。”
李裕祁怒喝道。
闻言，陆宸不再隐藏气息，将自己的真实修为展现出来。
“好……好强……的武道气息，这已经超越了武圣，不……是已经超越了武帝，你……你……你……你竟然是一尊武神境超级强者。”
感受到陆宸那他看不懂的武道气息，前一刻还在愤怒的李裕祁吓得说话都不利索了。
他的身体和声音都在颤抖，看陆宸的眼中则是充满了恐惧，整个人如坠冰窖。
作为一个修行了两百多年的人，他太清楚武神意味着什么，他和武神又有着多大差距。
可笑之前他在发现小乞丐带着陆宸前来之时没有第一时间逃，还觉得能够杀了陆宸。
就陆宸的修为，别说他只是七品后期巅峰修为的魂修，就算是九品后期巅峰也得死。
这一刻，他终于明白为何他的攻击在陆宸面前如此不堪一击，原来自己真是蝼蚁。
陆宸道：“你不是问我是什么人吗？我现在告诉你，我叫陆无命，世人称我为……人皇！”
“人……人皇！
！”

当陆宸说出陆无命三个字时，他便觉得熟悉，好像在哪听过，接着陆宸就说出了人皇。
一瞬间，李裕祁想到了近年来自己听说过的人皇事迹，吓得整个人都蜷缩了起来。
同一时间，一直晃荡在城中，听说过人皇的小乞丐也是一脸不可思议的看着陆宸。
之后，他瞪大眼睛问道：“恩公，您真是大家口中那个拯救世人的人皇大人？”
“怎么？不像？”
陆宸笑着问。
“不是不像，就是觉得很不可思议，小霖这种人居然也有一天能见到人皇大人。”
小乞丐道。
陆宸问道：“小霖，你全名叫什么？”
小乞丐笑着回答：“回恩公，小霖全名叫赵玉霖。”
“嗯，这个名字不错。”
陆宸笑着点头。
小乞丐尴尬的笑了笑：“小霖也不知道这个名字好不好，反正是爹娘给的。”
陆宸闻言问道：“小霖，你爹娘呢？”
“爹娘在小霖五岁的时候就被仇人杀了，在那之后，小霖就成了乞丐，到处流浪。”
小霖眼神黯淡了下来，低着头说。
陆宸摸着赵玉霖的脑袋，温柔的问道：“小霖，你我有缘，不知你可愿拜我为师？”
陆宸这一开口，赵玉霖震惊的问道：“恩公，小霖真的能拜你为师吗？”
同一时间，一旁重伤的李裕祁也是一脸的不可思议，随后想到了一个可能。
这一刻，他怀疑赵玉霖比他猜想的更妖孽，应该是拥有某种极为强大的武体。
content_en:
Seeing that the little beggar understood, Lu Chen took the opportunity to educate him again: "Xiao Lin, some bad people are directly bad, and some bad people are hypocritically bad. Just like your fake grandpa, they will pretend to be good people. This kind of bad people are more dangerous. You should be more careful about this kind of bad people in the future."
The little beggar carefully wrote down: "My benefactor, Xiaolin has written it down."
Li Yuqi was dissatisfied with a mocking look on his face: "You sound like you are a good person. Aren't you still worried about the body of this little beast and want to take away this little beast? Otherwise, you would save such an ant?"
"People are different. You will never understand what I do."
Lu Chen said indifferently.
Li Yuqi didn't believe it at all, and said to the little beggar: "Little beast, just wait. When you are a little stronger, he will take your body and become you, because even the Martial Saint cannot resist the temptation of your body."
Lu Chen sarcastically said: "You don't have to try so hard to drive a wedge between me and Xiaolin, because I can't take him away."
"I don't believe it."
Li Yuqi shouted angrily.
Hearing this, Lu Chen no longer concealed his aura and showed his true cultivation.
"So... so strong... the martial arts aura, this has surpassed the Martial Saint, no... has surpassed the Martial Emperor, you... you... you... you are actually a super strong person in the Martial God Realm."
Feeling Lu Chen's martial arts aura that he couldn't understand, Li Yuqi, who was angry just a moment ago, was so frightened that he couldn't even speak.
His body and voice were trembling, and when he looked at Lu Chen, his eyes were full of fear, and his whole body felt like he had fallen into an ice cellar.
As a person who has been practicing for more than two hundred years, he knows very well what the Martial God means, and how far he is from the Martial God.
It's ridiculous that he didn't run away immediately when he found out that the little beggar had brought Lu Chen, and he thought he could kill Lu Chen.
As far as Lu Chen's cultivation was concerned, let alone a soul cultivator with peak late-seventh-grade cultivation, even a peak late-ninth-grade soul cultivator would have to die.
At this moment, he finally understood why his attacks were so vulnerable to Lu Chen. It turned out that he was really an ant.
Lu Chen said: "Aren't you asking me who I am? I'm telling you now, my name is Lu Wuming, and the world calls me...Human Emperor!"
“Human…Human Emperor!
! "
When Lu Chen said the words "Lu Wu Ming", he felt familiar, as if he had heard it somewhere, and then Lu Chen said "Human Emperor".
For a moment, Li Yuqi thought of the deeds of the Human Emperor that he had heard about in recent years, and he was so scared that he cowered up.
At the same time, the little beggar who had been wandering around the city and had heard of the Human Emperor also looked at Lu Chen in disbelief.
Afterwards, he widened his eyes and asked, "My dear benefactor, are you really the Human Emperor that everyone says is the one who saves the world?"
"What? It doesn't look like it?"
Lu Chen asked with a smile.
"It's either that he doesn't look the same, or I just find it incredible that someone like Xiao Lin can actually meet the Emperor of Humanity one day."
said the little beggar.
Lu Chen asked: "Xiao Lin, what is your full name?"
The little beggar smiled and replied: "Replying to my benefactor, Xiaolin's full name is Zhao Yulin."
"Well, that's a good name."
Lu Chen smiled and nodded.
The little beggar smiled awkwardly: "Xiao Lin doesn't know if this name is good or not. Anyway, it was given by my parents."
Lu Chen heard this and asked, "Xiao Lin, where are your parents?"
"My parents were killed by enemies when Xiaolin was five years old. After that, Xiaolin became a beggar and wandered around."
Xiaolin's eyes dimmed and he lowered his head and said.
Lu Chen touched Zhao Yulin's head and asked gently: "Xiao Lin, we are destined to be together. I wonder if you would like to become my teacher?"
When Lu Chen opened his mouth, Zhao Yulin asked in shock: "My lord, can Xiaolin really accept you as his teacher?"
At the same time, Li Yuqi, who was seriously injured on the side, also looked incredulous, and then thought of a possibility.
At this moment, he suspected that Zhao Yulin was more evil than he had guessed, and that he must have some kind of extreme power.Powerful martial arts.
